name: Analyze airspace restrictions near proposed venue locations
description: Map Class B/C/D airspace boundaries against warehouse sites using SkyVector or AirMap software to identify no-fly zones before application submission.

name: Consult specialist for airworthiness gap analysis
description: Hire an Aviation Regulatory Specialist with expertise in UAV liability and commercial drone law to review hardware airworthiness requirements against Part 107 standards.

name: Compile documents and pay application fees
description: Gather necessary legal counsel input for accuracy and process the $5,000 per location licensing fees required by the FAA prior to filing applications.

name: Submit FAA Part 107 license applications online
description: File all three location license applications through the FAA DroneZone portal within the March 2026 deadline to ensure operational compliance and launch readiness.

name: Prepare internal risk assessment and financial data
description: Compile CAPEX budgets, safety protocols, and operational risk profiles required for underwriting review.

name: Contact specialized UAV liability insurance carriers
description: Identify and reach out to high-risk aviation underwriters specializing in commercial drone operations.

name: Review underwriting requirements and submit formal applications
description: Ensure all regulatory proofs are included and complete submission processes for binding quotes.

name: Compare quotes and finalize binding coverage agreement
description: Analyze premium costs, exclusions, and liability limits to select optimal carrier and sign contract.

name: Engage aviation regulatory specialist consultant
description: Hire an expert with UAV liability expertise to review hardware airworthiness gap analysis and provide feasibility advice for airspace restrictions.

name: Map airspace boundaries near venue sites
description: Utilize SkyVector or AirMap software to map Class B C D airspace boundaries against proposed warehouse sites for flight envelope compliance.

name: Simulate LAANC requests for target coordinates
description: Use FAA DroneZone portal to simulate LAANC request submissions and verify authorization availability status for all three target coordinates.

name: Validate restrictions with FAA District Office
description: Consult FAA District Office regarding airspace waiver feasibility and validate Class B C D access permissions before lease signing.

name: Compile risk analysis report for lease decisions
description: Compile findings into a risk analysis report comparing venue options to support final lease decision making and mitigation planning.

name: Identify potential warehouse locations
description: Search for industrial properties in target cities meeting size and zoning requirements for drone operations.

name: Negotiate lease terms and conditions
description: Discuss rent rates, duration, CAM fees, and specific clauses regarding high-density drone activity usage rights.

name: Conduct legal review of documentation
description: Have counsel review lease drafts for liability waivers, insurance requirements, and airspace restriction clauses.

name: Execute final lease agreement with owner
description: Sign the finalized contract and pay initial deposits to secure the property rights for venue setup.

name: Design HVAC system layout for warehouse safety
description: Calculate heat load and fume removal requirements to meet FAA Part 107 ventilation standards. Define ductwork paths avoiding structural conflicts. Deliver approved engineering schematics for permit submission.

name: Secure permits and source specialized equipment
description: Obtain commercial ventilation permit approvals from local authorities. Procure industrial HVAC units capable of high-density drone operation heat loads. Manage supply chain risks for delivery timelines.

name: Mount ventilation units and ductwork infrastructure
description: Physically install HVAC units on warehouse ceiling trusses. Connect ducting to ensure proper air circulation in player corridors. Ensure structural integrity during mounting process.

name: Conduct airflow testing and safety certification
description: Perform pressure tests to verify air exchange rates meet safety codes. Validate fume removal efficiency during peak simulation loads. Obtain final occupancy clearance for operations.

name: Source certified ballistic netting materials
description: Procure safety-rated netting with confirmed lead times to prevent supply chain delays before lease finalization.

name: Assess ceiling truss load-bearing capacity
description: Perform structural engineering analysis on warehouse trusses to verify mounting points can withstand impact forces.

name: Install netting around player corridors zones
description: Physically mount and secure netting systems along designated flight paths ensuring no gaps in coverage.

name: Conduct tension and impact load verification tests
description: Validate installed system integrity through stress testing to ensure compliance with safety standards prior to opening.

name: Identify potential drone suppliers
description: Research and vet vendors capable of supplying quadcopters with LiDAR obstacle avoidance systems to ensure hardware availability within budget constraints.

name: Request quotes for LiDAR systems
description: Contact selected vendors to obtain pricing details and technical specifications for required drone models to compare value propositions.

name: Negotiate binding purchase orders
description: Finalize contract terms including pricing, warranties, and expedited delivery clauses with preferred vendor to secure inventory supply.

name: Arrange expedited shipping logistics
description: Coordinate transportation logistics to ensure hardware arrives within the required timeline avoiding supply chain delays or bottlenecks.

name: Procure custom collision sensor hardware batches
description: Acquire necessary LiDAR or radar sensor units from approved suppliers ensuring compatibility with existing quadcopter models.

name: Mount sensors and wire connections on frames
description: Physically attach collision avoidance hardware to drone chassis and secure wiring harnesses for power and data transmission.

name: Develop software drivers for sensor data integration
description: Create firmware interfaces allowing flight controllers to process real-time obstacle detection data from new sensors.

name: Calibrate systems and test latency performance
description: Run calibration routines and stress tests to verify low latency and accurate obstacle detection before deployment.

name: Source custom collision sensor hardware components
description: Procure specific LiDAR and ultrasonic sensors required for obstacle avoidance integration into existing quadcopter models ensuring compatibility with flight controllers.

name: Physically mount sensors onto quadcopter frames
description: Securely attach collision detection hardware to drone chassis ensuring balance is maintained and wiring is protected from vibration damage.

name: Calibrate sensor data feeds for low latency
description: Adjust sensitivity thresholds and synchronize data streams to minimize processing delays during flight operations ensuring real-time response.

name: Execute redundant safety system stress tests
description: Run repeated high-intensity collision simulations to verify sensor reliability and fail-safe mechanisms under operational pressure conditions.

name: Finalize integration validation prior to deployment
description: Complete final certification of integrated systems confirming all safety protocols meet operational standards before launch to public users.

name: Identify potential veterans group partners
description: Research and compile a list of local or national veterans organizations that align with the venue's narrative goals while avoiding active conflict endorsement sensitivities.

name: Consult on narrative boundaries and legal limits
description: Schedule meetings with selected groups to discuss acceptable themes, ensuring clear legal boundaries regarding military conflict endorsement to prevent community backlash.

name: Draft non-binding MOUs for legal review
description: Create draft MOUs outlining partnership terms, role definitions, and safety compliance commitments requiring legal review before any binding commitments are made.

name: Finalize agreements with legal counsel oversight
description: Review final drafts with stakeholders and legal team, obtain necessary approvals, and execute signed partnership agreements to establish formal collaboration status.

name: Define corporate package tiers and offerings
description: Objective: Establish distinct service levels for team-building events including duration, drone count, and instructor ratios to create a baseline for pricing analysis. Scope: Product definition phase. Steps: Draft tier options and feature sets. Deliverables: Documented package specifications.

name: Analyze competitor pricing models for context
description: Objective: Research similar entertainment venues and corporate event providers to benchmark price points. Scope: Market analysis phase. Steps: Identify competitors, collect public pricing data, compare features. Deliverables: Competitor pricing report.

name: Conduct market research with potential clients
description: Objective: Engage target corporate buyers through interviews to understand budget constraints and perceived value. Scope: Customer discovery phase. Steps: Schedule interviews, conduct sessions, record feedback. Deliverables: Client interview transcripts.

name: Conduct price sensitivity testing sessions
description: Objective: Execute A/B pricing tests or surveys to measure demand fluctuation across different price points. Scope: Validation phase. Steps: Design survey, distribute samples, analyze response rates. Deliverables: Sensitivity analysis report.

name: Finalize pricing strategy based on collected data
description: Objective: Synthesize research findings to set optimal prices that meet margin targets while ensuring competitive uptake. Scope: Decision making phase. Steps: Review all reports, adjust margins, approve final rates. Deliverables: Approved price list.

name: Identify and vet potential regional franchise partners
description: Research and screen prospective regional operators based on market reach and operational capability criteria to ensure alignment with brand standards before formal engagement.

name: Develop financial viability and safety compliance documentation
description: Compile detailed business case reports including CAPEX breakdowns, ROI projections, and FAA Part 107 certification proof to address partner risk concerns regarding sustainability.

name: Present business viability evidence to potential partners
description: Schedule and conduct pitch meetings where financial models and safety protocols are reviewed with stakeholders to build trust and demonstrate operational readiness for expansion.

name: Finalize agreements and collect signed non-binding LOIs
description: Review terms of engagement drafts with interested parties and obtain formal letters of intent confirming commitment to regional development without binding financial obligations yet.

name: Enroll instructors in accelerated training cohorts
description: Identify eligible staff members and register them for immediate FAA Part 107 preparation courses to meet opening deadlines.

name: Schedule FAA certification exams with buffer time
description: Coordinate exam dates with testing centers ensuring sufficient lead time before the venue launch date to avoid delays.

name: Verify operational readiness via practical assessments
description: Conduct flight proficiency checks and safety protocol evaluations to confirm all instructors meet competency standards prior to public opening.

name: Prepare internal compliance documentation package
description: Compile all safety logs, HVAC test results, and network security audit reports required by regulatory bodies prior to official review.

name: Schedule regulatory body inspections and audits
description: Contact FAA inspectors, Fire Department officials, and local zoning authorities to secure dates for final venue clearance inspections within the timeline.

name: Execute physical safety walkthroughs and checks
description: Perform on-site verification of ballistic netting, emergency stop zones, and ventilation systems against established safety standards during scheduled inspection windows.

name: Remediate identified non-compliance findings
description: Address any deficiencies flagged during inspections immediately through repairs or procedural changes to ensure full regulatory compliance before launch approval.

name: Secure final operational sign-off certificates
description: Obtain official clearance documents and occupancy permits from all relevant authorities confirming the venue is safe for public operation.

name: Finalize creative assets and branding materials
description: Design promotional visuals, draft press releases, and secure brand guidelines approval for the tactical sport theme.

name: Secure media channels and schedule ad placements
description: Negotiate contracts with local digital platforms and traditional outlets to maximize reach before opening day launch.

name: Monitor engagement metrics and adjust spend dynamically
description: Track click-through rates daily to optimize budget allocation for maximum customer acquisition during the launch window.
